entities.text: High Court Of Delhi At New Delhi
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Petitioners
 Through: Mr. R.P. Dwivedi, Adv. alongwith
 petitioners in person.

Respondents
 Through: Ms. Richa Dhawan, App for the State
 with Si Ankit Maan, Ps Ranhola,
 Delhi.

Coram:
 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Anish Dayal
 Order

This petition has been filed for quashing of FIR No.422/2018 registered under Section 498A/406/506/34 IPC and Sections 3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Act, at PS Ranhola, Delhi, on the ground of a settlement between the parties dated 17.10.2019 arrived at with the facilitation of Delhi Mediation Centre, Tis Hazari Courts, Delhi.

2. The petitioner No.1 and respondent No.2, who had matrimonial disputes, had, as per the settlement decided to amicably resolve the disputes and are staying together with harmony with their children.
Petitioner Nos.1 - 5 and respondent No.2/complainant are present in the Court, duly identified by the counsel and the IO.
Petitioner No.1 and respondent No.2 confirm the position, as stated above.

3. Considering the above settlement between the parties and the chances of conviction of the petitioners being remote and bleak, there is no use continuing with proceedings of the present FIR as it would be a misuse of the process of the Court and an unnecessary burden on the State exchequer.

Consequently, the FIR No.422/2018 registered under Section 498A/406/506/34 IPC and Sections 3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Act, at PS Ranhola,
Delhi, and proceedings emanating therefrom are quashed.
Parties shall abide by the terms of settlement.
4. Accordingly, the petition is disposed of.
Pending applications, if any, are disposed of as infructuous.
5. Order be uploaded on the website of this Court.

ANISH DAYAL, J MARCH 20, 2023/kct Abdul Salam And Ors vs State And Ors on 20 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/175888247/
